p: trouble: For though they have much yet it is full of trouble and care.
sacrifice of the wicked is an: That thing is abominable before God, which the wicked think to be most excellent, and by which they think most to be accepted.
forsaketh the way: He who swears from the word of God, cannot stand to be admonished.
Hell and destruction are before the: There is nothing so deep or secret that can be hid from the eyes of God, much less man's thoughts.
thorns: That is, he always finds some hinderance or stay, and dares not go forward.
in the multitude of counsellors they: Read Pr 11:14.
in due season: If we will that our talk be comfortable, we must wait for time and season.
pleasant words: That is, wholesome and profitable to the hearers.
reproof of life abideth among the: That suffers himself to be admonished by God's word, which brings life: and so amends.
humility: Meaning, that God exalts no one but them that are truly humbled.
